name: localgravity
description: Local-first, privacy-first agentic IDE powered by Electron + FastAPI + Ollama

scripts.dev: concurrently -n electron,frontend,backend -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:electron" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd electron && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../electron && npm run lint
